abilities.name: Filch
abilities.effect: Steal an item from one enemy. Success rate based on Sable's Speed vs. enemy Speed. Each enemy has a common and rare steal.
abilities.description: Steal an item from an enemy. Requires front row.

abilities.name: Smokescreen
abilities.effect: Reduces all enemies' accuracy by 30% for 2 turns. If Sable has a stolen Forgewright component, also reduces enemy Speed by 15%.
abilities.description: Blanket the field in smoke, reducing enemy accuracy.

abilities.name: Shiv
abilities._comment: thrown_item_ability_mult equals ability_mult on purpose: the throw re-elements the same hit and changes nothing else (abilities.md § Damage Magnitudes > 'Shiv'; #359). thrown_item_element_field names the item field the element is read from.
abilities.effect: Quick physical attack (ability_mult 1.0) that ignores 50% of target's Defense. If Sable has a stolen item, she can throw it instead of striking bare: the same hit at the same multiplier and the same 50% DEF ignore, carrying the item's thrown element (items.md § Thrown-Item Elements) so it can hit a weakness. Most items are non-elemental and add nothing. The item is consumed either way.
abilities.description: A quick strike that pierces enemy defenses.

abilities.name: Misdirect
abilities.effect: Forces one enemy to target a different ally than intended on its next attack. Against AoE attacks, Misdirect has no effect. Against non-physical actions (spells), it redirects the targeting as normal. If used on a boss, instead reduces the boss's next attack damage by 25%.
abilities.description: Redirect an enemy's next attack to a different target.

abilities.name: Ransack
abilities.effect: Steal from all enemies simultaneously. Lower success rate than Filch (70% of normal), but hits everyone.
abilities.description: Steal from all enemies at once. Requires front row.

abilities.name: Wild Card
abilities._comment: target records the 1-3 item branches; the 0-item branch is single-target (abilities.md § Damage Magnitudes > 'Wild Card'). ability_mult is the 0-2 item value, ability_mult_max the 3-item one.
abilities.effect: Sable improvises a powerful technique based on her current stolen goods. 0 items: physical damage to one enemy at ability_mult 2.0 ("2x her Attack"). 1 item: the same 2.0 strike against all enemies, carrying the thrown item's element. 2 items: as 1 item, plus a random debuff (Poison, Sleep, Silence, Blind, or Slow) on all enemies. 3 items: heavy — ability_mult 3.0 against all enemies, elemental, random debuff, and restores 10% HP to all allies. All stolen items are consumed. Item-steal component requires front row.
abilities.description: Improvise a powerful attack fueled by stolen goods.

abilities.name: Unbreakable Thread
abilities.effect: Passive. Once per battle, when any ally would be reduced to 0 HP, they survive at 1 HP instead. Triggers automatically — Sable does not need to act. She just needs to be alive and in the active party.
abilities.description: Sable's presence alone prevents one fatal blow per battle.
